citations.assessment: Rav Chananya and Rav Oshaya both withdraw from the bathhouse. The cited Bavli assigns the instruction to Rav Oshaya alone and names Kafri as the place associated with Rav Chisda. The next unit says someone arrived at Sura, where Hamnuna spoke. The quote preserves Heilprin’s compressed plural and pronouns.
